\section[(dialogue)]{Seasons and months — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PA-R107-first-pass-seasons-and-months}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for both and several.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item midnight, daybreak, the day after tomorrow, summer, winter
  \item the rainy season, spring, autumn, every day, a date
  \item right now, January, February, March, April
  \item May, June, July, August, September
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Midnight? (\textbf{\pa{ਅੱਧੀ} \pa{ਰਾਤ}}, \emph{adhī rāt}.) Daybreak? (\textbf{\pa{ਤੜਕਾ}}, \emph{taṛkā}.) The day after tomorrow? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਰਸੋਂ}}, \emph{parsõ}.) Summer? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਰਮੀ}}, \emph{garmī}.) Winter? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਰਦੀ}}, \emph{sardī}.) The rainy season? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਰਸਾਤ}}, \emph{barsāt}.) Spring? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਸੰਤ}}, \emph{basant}.) Autumn? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਤਝੜ}}, \emph{patjhaṛ}.) Every day? (\textbf{\pa{ਰੋਜ਼}}, \emph{roz}.) A date? (\textbf{\pa{ਤਾਰੀਖ਼}}, \emph{tārīkh}.) Right now? (\textbf{\pa{ਹੁਣੇ}}, \emph{huṇe}.) January? (\textbf{\pa{ਜਨਵਰੀ}}, \emph{janvarī}.) February? (\textbf{\pa{ਫ਼ਰਵਰੀ}}, \emph{farvarī}.) March? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਾਰਚ}}, \emph{mārc}.) April? (\textbf{\pa{ਅਪ੍ਰੈਲ}}, \emph{aprail}.) May? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਈ}}, \emph{maī}.) June? (\textbf{\pa{ਜੂਨ}}, \emph{jūn}.) July? (\textbf{\pa{ਜੁਲਾਈ}}, \emph{julāī}.) August? (\textbf{\pa{ਅਗਸਤ}}, \emph{agast}.) September? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਤੰਬਰ}}, \emph{satambar}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Months and this and that — a second pass}

\label{lesson:PA-R107-second-pass-months-and-this-and-that}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for October and November.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item October, November, December, Chet, Visakh
  \item Jeth, Harh, Savan, Bhadon, Assu
  \item Kattak, Magghar, Poh, Magh, Phaggan
  \item somewhere, ever, each, such, every
  \item something, oneself, one's own, both, several
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
October? (\textbf{\pa{ਅਕਤੂਬਰ}}, \emph{aktūbar}.) November? (\textbf{\pa{ਨਵੰਬਰ}}, \emph{navambar}.) December? (\textbf{\pa{ਦਸੰਬਰ}}, \emph{dasambar}.) Chet? (\textbf{\pa{ਚੇਤ}}, \emph{cet}.) Visakh? (\textbf{\pa{ਵਿਸਾਖ}}, \emph{visākh}.) Jeth? (\textbf{\pa{ਜੇਠ}}, \emph{jeṭh}.) Harh? (\textbf{\pa{ਹਾੜ}}, \emph{hāṛ}.) Savan? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਾਵਣ}}, \emph{sāvaṇ}.) Bhadon? (\textbf{\pa{ਭਾਦੋਂ}}, \emph{bhādõ}.) Assu? (\textbf{\pa{ਅੱਸੂ}}, \emph{assū}.) Kattak? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੱਤਕ}}, \emph{kattak}.) Magghar? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੱਘਰ}}, \emph{magghar}.) Poh? (\textbf{\pa{ਪੋਹ}}, \emph{poh}.) Magh? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਾਘ}}, \emph{māgh}.) Phaggan? (\textbf{\pa{ਫੱਗਣ}}, \emph{phaggaṇ}.) Somewhere? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਿਤੇ}}, \emph{kite}.) Ever? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਦੇ}}, \emph{kade}.) Each? (\textbf{\pa{ਹਰੇਕ}}, \emph{harek}.) Such? (\textbf{\pa{ਅਜਿਹਾ}}, \emph{ajihā}.) Every? (\textbf{\pa{ਹਰ}}, \emph{har}.) Something? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੁਝ}}, \emph{kujh}.) Oneself? (\textbf{\pa{ਆਪ}}, \emph{āp}.) One's own? (\textbf{\pa{ਆਪਣਾ}}, \emph{āpṇā}.) Both? (\textbf{\pa{ਦੋਵੇਂ}}, \emph{dovẽ}.) Several? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਈ}}, \emph{kaī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
